Risk-research WT-D20260514_003 진행 중 동시 진행 (자원 충분, 자율 mandate). **활용 학술 자료 (01_Literature 보유)**: (1) `01_Literature/3.Risk & Portfolio Management/SSRN-Machine Learning Risk Model(2019).pdf`, (2) `01_Literature/2.Asset Allocation/2-1.Regime_Dynamic/2510.14986_RegimeFolio_Regime_Aware_ML_Sectoral_Portfolio.pdf` (2025-10), (3) `01_Literature/1.Factor_investment/1-6.IdioVol_LowRisk/2507.07107_ML_Enhanced_Multi-Factor_Quantitative_Trading.pdf` (2025-07), (4) `01_Literature/Korea_Research/deep_analysis.md` + `deep_analysis_fulltext.md`. Gu-Kelly-Xiu (2020 RFS) Empirical Asset Pricing via ML 정통 + Chen-Pelger-Zhu (2024 JFE) Deep Factor Model + Kelly-Malamud-Zhou (2024 JoF) The Virtue of Complexity. **ML pkg 가용**: xgboost / ranger / randomForest / glmnet / caret (CPU only, GPU torch 미작동). **자율 탐색 후보 axes (ex-ante grid N≤5 strict, AX-002)**: (1) **Multi-factor ML ensemble** — STR_1715 H1 component factors (C01_SUE / C02_EPS_Chg_1m / C04_ESBR / C06_TP_Gap / Q07 / M08 / Q25) + INV01~12 + D family + V family 등 multi-factor → XGBoost/RandomForest/Ridge ensemble, cross-sectional ML on rank_IC, (2) **Regime-conditional ML** — 4-bucket regime (BULL/NORMAL/CAUTION/CRISIS) 별 independent ML training, regime-specific factor weight (RegimeFolio 2025 정통), (3) **Interaction feature engineering** — factor × factor / factor × regime / factor × sector cross terms ML, (4) **Idio-vol ML enhancement** — D family residualized + ML (Ang 2006 + 2507.07107 정통, low-vol family ML enhance), (5) **Macro-conditional ML** — 거시 변수 (FRED + ECOS 시차 lag 적용) regime interaction ML cross-section. **Universe**: KR_EQUITY_FULL_KOSPI_KOSDAQ_ALL_LIQ_2E8_FILTERED (~2,657 cover). WT-D20260514_003 universe expansion path 학습 inherit. **Universe + ML 결합 가설**: full universe small/mid-cap 추가 + ML nonlinear interaction으로 portfolio realized cor 0.40 mandate barrier breaking 가능성. WT-D20260514_003 저변동성 single-factor가 0.0292 이미 PASS, 본 cycle은 multi-factor ML enhance로 SR boost 추가 시도. **L-316/L-317 mandate retain**: alpha 단계 Pareto 6축 portfolio realized cor 선제 측정 의무. **PIT C1~C15 strict**: ML training rolling/expanding window only (full-sample 금지 — C1 위반 위험), OOS lockbox 명시, t+1 lag (C2), hyperparameter tuning은 walk-forward (no peek-ahead). **Data source**: Factor DB load_month_factors() 경유 (C15 정합). **Codex Round 5단계 의무**. **AX 정합**: AX-002 ex-ante grid N≤5 strict + AX-001 v2 4-axis + AX-005/007 EXEMPT (multi-axis composite + multi-sleeve) + AX-008 Codex Round 의무.
